parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of plastic, located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism by releasing water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or horizontally when pressed to trigger the flush valve.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Lid)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic cover placed on top of the toilet tank to protect internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents dust and debris from entering the tank and provides a finished appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted off for maintenance but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Lid (Seat Lid)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the toilet seat when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It provides hygiene and aesthetic coverage, and can be closed to prevent odors.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A contoured plastic ring attached to the toilet bowl for sitting.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and hygienic surface for the user to sit on.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or lowered via hinges for cleaning or use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and plumbing.
